#!/bin/bash
# Universal Installation Script
cd /mnt/server || exit 1

DEBUG="${DEBUG:-0}"
[ "${DEBUG}" = "1" ] && set -x

GIT_REPO="${GIT_REPO:-}"
GIT_BRANCH="${GIT_BRANCH:-main}"
GIT_AUTH_TOKEN="${GIT_AUTH_TOKEN:-}"
STARTER_TEMPLATE="${STARTER_TEMPLATE:-}"
AUTO_INSTALL_DEPS="${AUTO_INSTALL_DEPS:-1}"
EXTRA_URLS="${EXTRA_URLS:-}"

if [ -n "${GIT_REPO}" ]; then
    AUTH_REPO_URL="${GIT_REPO}"
    if [ -n "${GIT_AUTH_TOKEN}" ] && [[ "${GIT_REPO}" =~ ^https:// ]]; then
        AUTH_REPO_URL="https://${GIT_AUTH_TOKEN}@${GIT_REPO#https://}"
    fi
    if [ -d ".git" ]; then
        git fetch origin "${GIT_BRANCH}" 2>/dev/null || true
        git reset --hard "origin/${GIT_BRANCH}" 2>/dev/null || git pull || true
    else
        git clone --branch "${GIT_BRANCH}" --depth 1 "${AUTH_REPO_URL}" . || git clone --depth 1 "${AUTH_REPO_URL}" . || true
    fi
fi

if [ -n "${EXTRA_URLS}" ]; then
    IFS=$'\n'
    for line in ${EXTRA_URLS}; do
        [ -z "${line}" ] && continue
        dest=""
        url="${line}"
        case "${line}" in *\|*) dest="${line%%|*}"; url="${line#*|}" ;; esac
        filename=$(basename "${url}" | sed 's/[?].*//')
        target="${filename}"
        [ -n "${dest}" ] && mkdir -p "${dest}" && target="${dest}/${filename}"
        curl -fsSL --retry 2 -o "${target}" "${url}" || true
    done
fi

if [ "${AUTO_INSTALL_DEPS}" = "1" ]; then
    if [ -f "package.json" ]; then
        npm install --no-audit --no-fund 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
    if [ -f "requirements.txt" ]; then
        pip3 install -r requirements.txt 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
fi

chown -R 988:988 /mnt/server 2>/dev/null || chown -R 1000:1000 /mnt/server 2>/dev/null || true
echo "[install][OK] Initial setup complete."
